steps.observation: You have 300 seconds. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
1. Militarism – the arms race and glorification of military power made nations quick to resort to force.  
2. Alliance system – rigid treaties (e.g. Triple Entente vs. Triple Alliance) turned a regional crisis into a wider war.  
3. Imperialism (and rivalry for colonies) – competition over overseas empires heightened tensions among the Great Powers.
